messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT NOTICE — hosted-us-east-1: GPU pool depleted; request queue growing. P95/P99 jumping. Paging @natalie (oncall). Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/gpu-capacity

natalie (oncall): got it, joining. first check: is autoscaler spamming API errors?

raj (infra): seeing autoscaler errors: `quotaExceeded` from cloud provider around 18:02 UTC. Provisioner churned and failed to allocate new instances. logs snippet:
```
Autoscaler: request 8 -> failed: quotaExceeded: vgpu-cores quota
Provisioner: rate limit hit 429 from compute API
```

luis (sre): p95 jumped from 220ms -> 14s in the last 5m, p99 ~58s. Backlog ~62k requests on hosted queue, error 504s up ~12% for customers.

emma (support): getting a few messages from customers about timeouts on batch generation endpoints. One enterprise tenant reported 30% failed calls. I'll draft a public status update once we have mitigation.

natalie (oncall): Mitigations I can run now: 1) enable model-fallback routing to cpu-quantized variant for non-critical traffic 2) temporarily increase per-API-key rate limits for high-priority customers (soft throttle others) 3) open manual node provisioning ticket with infra. Which do we prefer?

raj (infra): cloud quota is the blocker — manual provisioning won't help until quota is increased or we reassign capacity from other pools. I recommend enabling fallback routing + throttle heavy keys. I'll request quota increase but it's slow.

luis (sre): +1 fallback routing. Also flip cache-prefetch off for long requests to reduce KV churn. Quick command to enable fallback routing (prod):
```
POST /v1/routing/policies/_apply
{ "policy": "fallback-to-quantized", "priority": "non_critical" }
```

natalie (oncall): doing the routing change now. Pasting command I ran: `curl -XPOST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/routing/policies/_apply -d '{"policy":"fallback-to-quantized","priority":"non_critical"}'`

ops-bot: ACTION: routing policy applied by natalie at 18:09 UTC — fallback-to-quantized active for non_critical (scope=hosted-us-east-1).

luis (sre): patching traffic throttle: add token_bucket for keys generating > 200r/s. This will shed load to keep queues stable.

emma (support): status draft -> "We are experiencing elevated request latencies and timeouts in hosted-us-east-1 due to GPU capacity constraints. We have activated fallback routing to alternative model variants and implemented temporary rate limiting for the heaviest traffic. Some customers may see degraded latency or 504s. Investigating — next update in 15 minutes." Send?

natalie (oncall): send it.

ops-bot: STATUS UPDATE posted to status.redwood at 18:14 UTC by emma.

raj (infra): quota request opened with cloud provider (case #CP-88102). Estimated time: unknown. Meanwhile, I can rebalance a few non-critical dedicated pools to hosted-us-east-1 to free 4 GPUs — will take ~12m to drain. Approve?

natalie (oncall): approve rebalancing now. Prioritize customers in EU/dedicated that are low usage.

luis (sre): Observability note: set a temporary alert if hosted queue > 40k and p99 > 30s — already firing. Also adding a manual eviction window for stale queued requests > 120s to limit backlog.

emma (support): customer-impact log: 3 enterprise tenants with elevated 5xxs (IDs: cust-847, cust-912, cust-333). Ops on it; CC their CSMs.

ops-bot: REBALANCE JOB started by raj at 18:21 UTC — migrating 4 GPUs from dedicated pools. ETA ~11m.

natalie (oncall): handing off to raj for the next 45m while I go get dinner — he'll monitor and escalate if rebalancing fails. I will remain reachable. @luis please stay for post-mortem notes.

raj (infra): accepted handoff. Monitoring rebalancer and autoscaler. If rebalancer doesn't free GPUs within 15m, plan B is to enable region-fallback routing to eu-west for burst traffic.

luis (sre): logging mitigation steps for postmortem: root cause likely cloud quota + bursty campaign traffic; mitigation: fallback routing, rate limiting, rebalancing, quota request. Need long term: pre-warming, quota automation, more graceful cross-region fallback.

ops-bot: INCIDENT NOTE appended to ticket INC-2026 by natalie at 18:30 UTC: "activated fallback routing; rate limits applied; rebalancer running; cloud quota request open; customers notified."

raj (infra): rebalancer finished at 18:33 UTC — freed 4 GPUs. Immediate signs: backlog dropping from 62k -> 19k over 6m, p95 improved to ~800ms, p99 ~6.3s. Still watching for recurrences.

natalie (oncall): great. I'll close the urgent pager and convert this to a follow-up postmortem channel. Final update to customers in 20m with root cause and next steps.

emma (support): posted final customer update at 18:49 UTC.

luis (sre): leaving notes: action items created — quota automation (A1), cross-region fallback tests (A2), burst detection + pre-warm (A3).

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED — hosted-us-east-1 GPU capacity restored and backlog reduced. Monitoring for 2 hours.
